title: Maula mehdi aa jaiye
body:
Maula mehdi aa jaiye
Al- ajal, al-ajal, al-ajal, al-ajal
<<DIVIDER>>
muntazir kab talak mai rahu ae imaam
meri saanse kahi ho na jaye tamaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye..(2)
Deedar ki aakhri aas mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Deedar ki aakhri aas mai
Khat likh raha hai ye khadim tumhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
1. Kijiye qabool aqa mera salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas ek azadar hai mera naam
Qabeel nahi janta hun magar
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hun khud ko tumhara ghulam
Kya hun mujhe khud ye batlaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
2. Faryaad e aur istaghase huzoor
<<DIVIDER>>
Sarkaar sunte to honge zaroor
Bechain khud bhi hai ghaibat me aap
<<DIVIDER>>
Kab hoga mola batadein zahoor
Humko na ab or tadpaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jayiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
3. Be noor kab se mere nain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanha azadaar e behrain hai
Kabaa ho ya ke ho Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab aapke gham mai bechain hai
Sarkaar tashreef le aaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
4. Lafzo se parda hatati nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Apna ta’aruf karati nahi
Jab se gaye aap khamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayat ma’ani batati nahi
Raaz e Alif laam samjhaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
5. Tarteeb marbut ho baat se
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahir jalalat ho aayaat se
Kehta hai zoq e talawat mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Likha jo Maula ne khud haath se
Mujko wo quraan padhwaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
6. Karni hai taskheer sham aap ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Lana hai haq ka nizaam aap ko
Aye waris e zulfiqaar e Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Lena hai jab intaqaam aapko
Gazi ko bhi saath le aaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
7. Hum jamkaraan or sehlaa gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ashko se apne arize likhe
Girya kiya or namaze padhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo the jatan, basme sab karliye
Har jah guzarish thi, aa jaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
8. Khat apna karta hun is par tamaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai mir bhi aap ka ek ghulaam
Hai sibt e jafar ki bhi iltija
<<DIVIDER>>
Kije talab ab hame ya imam
Ya aap tashreef le aaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Mehdi aa jaiye, Maula Mehdi aa jaiye
author: Mir Hassan Mir
